Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

We're writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for certain core functionality has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and that certification step now pushes our schedule back by two weeks.

Based on this, we're setting the new delivery date for 14 April. Our team is continuing development on all remaining components in parallel with the certification process, so no other part of the project is affected, and we will maintain close contact with the vendor to keep this date firm. Would the 14 April date still work with any downstream plans on your end.

We'll send you a progress update next week with a status check on the certification, and we're happy to set up a call in the meantime if you'd like to walk through the current build or discuss any adjustments on your side. Thank you for your continued patience and partnership as we work through this final step together.
